title: Data table
summary: A paged, searchable, sortable table that owns its data flow: a pk-table (manual), a pk-table-filters search/filter panel and a pk-pagination footer, with the query, the load and the states in one place. Set the load(query) callback as a property (business logic, never config data): it receives { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters } and, as a second argument, { signal }, an AbortSignal that aborts when a newer request replaces it or the element leaves the page (pass it to fetch), and returns (or resolves to) { rows, total, filterOptions? } for that page (filterOptions: { filterKey: [{ value, label }] } replaces those select filters' options, e.g. labels with counts). A loading state shows while in flight, a rejection shows the error state with Retry, zero rows the empty state, and a stale response is dropped. With selectable set, the selection survives paging and searching: selected holds the chosen ids, selectScope is 'page' (those ids) or 'all' (Select all N rows: the ids stay the loaded page). Each change raises pk-select with the ids, the scope and the current query, so for scope 'all' the host runs its bulk action against that query on the server. A search or filter change narrows scope 'all' back to 'page'. rowHref(row), also a callback property, makes rows clickable and is called with the row. pk-list-page and the lookup picker are built on this element.

props.name: columns
props.description: pk-table's column definitions ({ key, label, type?, align?, sortable?, hidePhone?, shed?, title? }[]). The table shows nothing without them.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filter fields beside the search box: [{ key, label, type?, options?, anyLabel? }] (type is a pk-input type, 'select' with options, or 'multiselect': a checklist of options whose chosen values arrive as an array, empty when none). Each is a labelled control; its value goes to load(query) as query.filters[key]. Controls are rebuilt only when this array changes, so typed values survive.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: The page size to start with (initial only; the user changes it in the pager).

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: The page sizes the pager offers, a number array; null (the default) gives the pager no size choice.

props.name: sort
props.description: The key of the column to sort by first (initial only; empty loads the default order).

props.name: sortDir
props.description: ascending or descending, for sort.

props.name: hideSearch
props.description: Hides the search box.

props.name: search
props.description: The search term to start with, for example from a query string: it fills the search box and the first load, and typing replaces it. Changing it later replaces the term and loads page 1.

props.name: filterValues
props.description: Filter values to start with, by key.

props.name: page
props.description: The page to load first (initial only).

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: The placeholder and accessible name of the search box (default "Search").

props.name: searchDebounce
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before searching.

props.name: pagerLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the pager (default "Pagination").

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the table.

props.name: caption
props.description: The table caption, as text.

props.name: empty
props.description: { heading?, description? } shown when a page has zero rows and nothing is searched; null shows the built-in empty state.

props.name: noResults
props.description: { heading?, description? } shown instead while a search or filter is active; null uses the empty state.

props.name: loadError
props.description: The heading of the failed-load message (with Retry).

props.name: addLabel
props.description: The text of a primary action button after the search box and the actions slot (for example "+ Add customer"); pressing it raises pk-add. Empty shows no button.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Show a checkbox column and the bulk bar, with 'Select all N rows' when the query has more rows than the page.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: The row field that identifies a row, which is what selected holds.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Rows can be activated: a click, or Enter or Space on the focused row (each row is a tab stop), raises pk-row-click with the row id. For a host that cannot pass a rowHref callback (a wrapper, a page that opens the row itself). Setting rowHref makes rows clickable too.

props.name: rowHrefTemplate
props.description: Row links: an address with {id} (and any {field}, URL-encoded), like /orders/{id} or #/orders/{id}. The first cell of each row becomes a real link; a plain click on it or the row goes through the router (pk-navigate). Plain data, so a wrapper can set it (rowHref is a callback).

props.name: navigate
props.description: Who follows a row link: router (default, empty), host or none.

props.name: currentRow
props.description: The id (rowKey value) of the row that is open elsewhere, for example in a detail pane: pk-table tints it, marks it with an accent bar and gives it aria-current. The host sets it, from the route or from pk-row-click.

props.name: cards
props.description: Rows become stacked cards on a phone, as pk-table's cards.

props.name: striped
props.description: Alternate row tint, as pk-table's striped.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height, as pk-table's density.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: A CSS length that caps the table's height (the rows scroll inside it), as pk-table's maxHeight; combine with stickyHeader.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keep the header row visible while the rows scroll, as pk-table's stickyHeader. In a flex column of definite height (a pk-stack[fill], an app-shell body) it fills that height: only the rows scroll, the pager and bulk bar stay in view. Without a definite height the table is as tall as its rows.

props.name: selected
props.description: The ids of the selected rows, as strings, across every page and search the reader has visited. Set it to preselect; read it (or the pk-select event) to act on the selection. For selectScope 'all' it is only the loaded page: expand the scope with the query.

props.name: selectPageOnly
props.description: With selectable: never offer 'Select all N rows'. The header checkbox selects the loaded page and selectScope stays 'page'; for a bulk action that works only on explicit ids.

props.name: selectScope
props.description: 'all' once the reader chose Select all N rows: every row of the current query is selected, not only the ids in selected.

slots.name: breadcrumb
slots.description: Breadcrumb at the start of the toolbar row; wraps when narrow.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Toolbar buttons at the end of the search row.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Content shown instead of the built-in empty state when load() returns no rows and no search or filter is active (an illustration, a call to action). With a search active the no-results slot, else the built-in state, shows.

slots.name: no-results
slots.description: Content shown instead of the built-in no-results state when a search or filter is active and nothing matches.

slots.name: bulk
slots.description: Bulk actions (buttons) shown in the bar that appears while rows are selected, beside the count; act on the pk-select detail (the ids, or the query for scope 'all'). Needs selectable.

slots.name: cell-<rowId>-<key>
slots.description: Custom content for one cell, exactly as pk-table's cell slots: the row's id (its rowKey field) and the column key. A row with no such child shows the plain value. Column options (align, type, hidePhone) in columns apply as in pk-table.

slots.name: header-<key>
slots.description: Content beside one column header's title (a help tooltip, an icon button), exactly as pk-table's header slots; the text title and the sort button stay.

events.name: pk-load-error
events.description: load() rejected: the built-in error state with Retry is showing. error is what it rejected with (not raised for a response a newer request overtook).

events.name: pk-query-change
events.description: The reader changed the query (sorted, searched, filtered, paged or chose a page size); raised before load() runs for it. Not raised for a prop set from script or for refresh(). Use it to keep SortKey, Search and PageSize in sync with the host (two-way binding).

events.name: pk-row-click
events.description: pk-table's own event, passed through: a clickable row was activated. id is the row's rowKey value, row the row object from load(). A control inside the row (checkbox, button, link) does not raise it.

events.name: pk-navigate
events.description: A click on a row link (pk-table's event, passed through).

events.name: pk-select

detail.query: { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters }

events.description: The selection changed (a row, the page or Select all N, a cleared selection, or a search that narrowed scope all to page). For scope 'all' run the bulk action against query on the server. pk-table's own pk-select and pk-select-all stop inside the element.

parts.name: toolbar
parts.description: Holds the filters and the actions, above the table.

parts.name: filters
parts.description: The pk-table-filters search/filter panel, in the toolbar above the table (it stays shown and focused while rows load and when nothing matches).

parts.name: actions
parts.description: Holds the actions slot, at the end of the toolbar.

parts.name: add
parts.description: The primary add button, after the actions slot (shown when addLabel is set).

parts.name: pagination
parts.description: The pk-pagination, in the table's footer.

parts.name: footer
parts.description: The table footer bar holding the pager.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: Holds the empty slot while it is shown.

parts.name: noResults
parts.description: Holds the no-results slot while shown.

parts.name: state
parts.description: Holds the loading/empty/error state while load() is in flight or the result is empty; the table is hidden while this is shown.

methods.name: focus(where?)
methods.description: Moves focus from the host. No argument: the search box, or the first row when the search is hidden. "search": the search box only (nothing while it is hidden or not drawn yet). "next": the row after the focused one, the first when no row has focus. "previous", "first", "last": only while a row has focus (the call does nothing otherwise, so Home and the arrows stay the search box's own). Returns whether focus moved.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Runs load(query) again for the current query, for example after a bulk action. Returns a promise.

methods.name: query
methods.description: A getter: a copy of the current query { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters }.

a11y: Every filter field is a labelled real control; the table, search box, bulk bar and pagination keep their own roles, names and announcements ('Select all N rows' is a named button); loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's roles.

examples.title: Orders (set load from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP; with none, the empty state shows)
examples.html: <pk-data-table selectable columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"},{"key":"name","label":"Name"}]' empty='{"heading":"No orders yet","description":"Orders you receive show here."}'></pk-data-table>

examples.title: Preset search (from a link) and no Select all offer
examples.html: <pk-data-table selectable select-page-only columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"}]' search="acme" no-results='{"heading":"Nothing matches acme"}'></pk-data-table>

examples.title: Page size, add button, labels and empty states (set load from script)
examples.html: <pk-data-table selectable columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"},{"key":"name","label":"Name"}]' page-size="10" add-label="+ Add product" search-label="Find a product" label="Products" empty='{"heading":"No products yet"}' no-results='{"heading":"No product matches"}'></pk-data-table>
